class.name: IfcSweptSurface
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A swept surface is one that is constructed by sweeping a curve along another curve. NOTE: Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: swept_surface. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p.76 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY: New entity in IFC Release 2x.

members.member: The curve to be swept in defining the surface. The curve is defined as a profile within the position coordinate system.
Position coordinate system for the placement of the profile within the xy plane of the axis placement.
